The '''''Calabar Queen''''' was a [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] owned by [[Imperial Corusca Line]]s.

==History==
The cruise [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was on its way to [[Cadomai Prime/Legends|Cadomai Prime]] when it was blown up. The [[Justice Action Network]] later claimed responsibility for the terrorist [[Attack on the Calabar Queen|strike]].
